nonuniform_extra_capacity.reason: FusedMoE requires num_global_routed % storage_ep_size == 0 and assigns the same num_local_experts to every rank. 256 logical + 1 global replica = 257 cannot be represented as 128/129 under the installed EP contract.

logical_route_unchanged.reason: The framework has logical-to-physical replica maps and can preserve top-k IDs/weights after mapping, but its physical expert count must be uniformly divisible across ranks.
evidence: sglang/srt/hardware_backend/npu/moe/topk.py: fused_topk_npu applies the logical-to-physical mapping while retaining topk weights

external_slot_execution.reason: The real NPU chain can execute from a slot-backed tensor view, but the native entry always reads layer-owned weight attributes; it has no slot handle in the dispatch or GMM contract.
evidence: sglang/srt/layers/moe/moe_runner/ascend.py: runner passes QuantInfo into w13/w2 kernels
This round's prior real expert-child harness succeeded by exposing the external slot as a temporary layer view.

correct_return.reason: DeepEP dispatch output carries topk IDs and topk weights into combine, which is the right identity to preserve original positions. No real 257-instance dispatch/combine was run because layout construction fails first.

all_rank_protocol.reason: The dispatcher, runner and EPLB metadata all assume a uniform physical expert count per rank. A distributed single extra slot would require explicit uneven per-rank expert ranges/buffers and matching zero-task branches.
evidence: DeepEP normal/low-latency buffer APIs receive a single global num_experts
NPU init routing passes expert_num=num_experts and active_expert_range=[0,num_experts]

decisive_blocker.short: 257 physical experts cannot enter the installed uniform per-rank expert sharding contract.
decisive_blocker.minimal_math: 257 % 2 = 1, while FusedMoE and ExpertLocationMetadata require remainder 0.

provide per-rank expert ranges and dispatcher buffer sizing
